purpose: Teach: 間際/色合い/メシ/大いなる/不可解/非常識/あきらか/捜し

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、出かける間際に忘れ物しないでね
lines.en: Sho, don't forget anything when you're heading out, okay?
lines.style: Light, practical reminder delivered as he's getting ready. Warm but matter-of-fact, the tone of someone who's given this reminder a hundred times. No drama.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんの絵の色合い、優しいね
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa's painting has really gentle colors, doesn't it?
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to himself. Pause before speaking, like he's noticing it for the first time even though it's always been there. Soft, genuine wonder.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さん、メシは何にする?って聞いてたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was asking what we should make for dinner earlier.
lines.style: Conversational aside, matter-of-fact. A small piece of information passed along while thinking about something else. No particular emphasis.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、大いなる希望を持ってるよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm holding onto a really big hope inside.
lines.style: Earnest and direct, speaking to something he's been thinking about. Not boastful—sincere. Clear pronunciation, steady pace. He means every word.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんの行動が不可解だわね
lines.en: Mom, Grandma's been acting kind of strange lately, hasn't she?
lines.style: Quiet observation wrapped in gentle humor. Not making fun—noticing something and pointing it out the way you'd mention the weather. A little amused by the puzzle of it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、非常識なお友達には注意してるよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm being careful around friends who have bad manners.
lines.style: Earnest and self-aware, like he's thought about this and made a choice. Not preachy—just stating something he takes seriously. A little proud of his own awareness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本当のお気持ちはあきらかにしてね
lines.en: Mom, can you tell me your real thoughts about this?
lines.style: Direct but gentle. He's asking for something real, not settling for the surface. Steady eye contact implied. No hesitation, but patient—waiting for her honesty.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、なくしたおもちゃ、捜してくれる?
lines.en: Mom, will you help me find my toy I lost?
lines.style: Simple, direct request with hope underneath. Not demanding—offering her the chance to help. Warm and open, the way he asks when he trusts the answer will be yes.
